entities.name: Jan Beyzym
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jan Beyzym, was a Jesuit priest of the Catholic Church in Poland. He was a teacher in Jesuit boarding schools for a time after his ordination and later left Poland to work alongside lepers in Madagascar where he remained until his death.
